author: Al3cs
text:
Hi Corsica, what this homework request to do is:

Mark at least 200 caps on your charts - there are so many to see that it won't take long. Draw a box from the cap to where price hit it later. Note how price approached the caps, and how it reacted. If price broke the cap, note what happened next. Was the cap still relevant?

I added RBD to your HW for all the newbie who comes here to look for some suggestion and learn how to complete the HW, as I did in the past.

IMO this HW is important for learn to watch and see the chart in a new way. No one ask us to trade the RBD and DBR here, but if we want there's the classroom thread or our journal.

For your questions.... Start simple, start the clean homework. All will be clearer in the future. Have a nice day
